subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped to command prompt metadata parity only, with selective channel delivery handled by a separate API/product decision?
rationale: The source-confirmed gap is narrow, but the broader selective reply-routing request conflicts with the documented host-controlled routing boundary and needs maintainer direction before automation.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
options.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()` only.

options.title: Split Selective Routing Design
options.body: Track prompt- or rule-driven channel delivery as a separate maintainer-approved API or product design item.

options.title: Reject Prompt-Driven Routing
options.body: Keep deterministic host-controlled routing and document that prompts cannot choose arbitrary delivery channels.

recommendation.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
recommendation.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance in `resolveCommandsSystemPromptBundle()` only.

likelyOwner.reason: The history and prior issue comment make this the clearest owner for the prompt-vs-routing scope decision.
